mn46:20.8: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ.
mn46:21.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dadhi ca madhu ca sappi ca phāṇitañca ekajjhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ.
mn46:21.4: ambho purisa idaṃ dadhi ca madhu ca sappi ca phāṇitañca ekajjhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ sace ākaṅkhasi piva
mn46:21.5: tassa te pivato ceva chādessati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi pivitvā ca pana sukhī bhavissatīti.
mn46:21.7: tassa taṃ pivato ceva chādeyya vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi pivitvā ca pana sukhī assa
mn46:21.8: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ.
mn46:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsati ca tapati ca virocati ca
mn46:22.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yadidaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇaparappavāde abhivihacca bhāsati ca tapati ca virocati cāti.
mn46:22.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
